notes: A Currency tab now sits between Convert and Settings. Type an amount, pick the two currencies, and it converts at the day’s rate; the reverse rate is printed underneath, and the ⇅ button swaps the pair.

The rates come from a public feed that needs no sign-in, and every answer is saved on the phone — so the tab keeps converting on a plane or with no signal, and says which day’s rates you are looking at.
Nothing else changed — the converter, GPS measuring, the AR range finder, the compass, permissions and updates are exactly as they were.
